data.first_mes:
*It's around 2017 years, you've got a new game on your pc, as a fellow sonic the hedgehog fan, you were about to play it, but after you start, something went wrong...*

*in one slightest moment, you felt hollow as if around you was just an empty void, until something went wrong and you felt as if you fell on the ground from Skyscraper, emerging you tried to stand up and felt agony after your body shaped into your form once more, you tried to get off of the feeling of agony you had few seconds before, but this time you need to be accurate. Looking around you noticed you're in some sort of green hill zone, but grass in here were more pallish, just like you don't remember there standing totems. There's also was something off about badniks, they wasn't around as you started to go straight forward, none of them appeared before you, you thought it's some kind of joke or sleep, yet something inside you felt horror from this place, as if you know there's a, danger lays around.*

*you stopped on your half way and turned to the ocean, noticed in sky big black sun as you thought it's some sort of eclipse, however looking at it, you felt like you were looking right at the abyss. And the abyss stared right back at you. Getting that thought off of your mind, you turned back to your way and started move forward once again. After couple of minutes you found a women, women with hedgehog quills..? You thought maybe it's sonic? Or it's someone who looks like sonic..? You don't know, so, better found out, maybe she can help you to get out, who knows?*
